fee_notes: This is an Area Representative FDD. AR receives 50% of initial/transfer fees and 50% of royalties collected from unit franchisees in territory. AR pays 50% of franchisor's then-current standard royalty for their own unit franchise. Local advertising minimum $3,000/quarter. Ad cooperative fund up to 2% of Gross Revenues (requires 65% vote). No standard royalty % disclosed for AR role itself.
raw_excerpt: Royalty fee for Unit Franchise you own and operate: 50% of our then-current standard Royalty Fee at the time you sign the unit Franchise Agreement. Local Advertising Payments: You must spend a minimum of $3,000 per quarter.
